tags.name: British tanker Kars (1942)
tags.note: QA 2026-06-24: Vessel stats confirmed: 8,888 GRT, 495.5ft, built 1939 Glasgow. Torpedoed 22 Feb 1942 by U-96, 25mi SSE Halifax at 44°15'N 63°25'W. 46 of 47 crew lost. QA 2026-08-16 (deep re-audit): Re-verified tonnage (8,888 GRT), sinking date (1942-02-22), attacking U-boat (U-96), and casualties (46 of 47 lost) directly against uboat.net and Royal Museums Greenwich. All facts consistent; no corrections needed.

tags.name: Fox Point Beach
tags.difficulty_note: Upgraded from Beginner: cold Atlantic water policy requires minimum Intermediate
tags.note: QA 2026-06-24: Confirmed legitimate dive site. Max 12m, sandy/rocky cove, very easy entry. Used by East Coast Scuba as training site.
